summary: Explains nesting loops via include_tasks, using loop_control loop_var to avoid the inner loop overwriting item; Ansible errors if a loop reuses an already defined variable.
questions: How do I nest loops using include_tasks?
Why does my inner loop overwrite the outer item?
How do I rename the loop variable?

answer_card.title: Stacking loops with include_tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# main.yml
- include_tasks: inner.yml
  loop: [1, 2, 3]
  loop_control:
    loop_var: outer_item

# inner.yml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "outer item={{ outer_item }} inner item={{ item }}"
  loop: [a, b, c]
```

Without `loop_var`, the inner `item` would overwrite the outer one; Ansible fails the task if it detects that.
